explanation.text: Page 1 contains the 1969 Vienna Convention, done at Vienna, and Article 53's rule that a treaty conflicting with a peremptory norm at its conclusion is void. Page 1 also states in Article 4 that the Convention applies only to treaties concluded after its entry into force, and pages 4 and 5 confirm that Article 53 operates only with respect to treaties concluded after the Convention entered into force for the parties. Thus the claim's 'only after entry into force' limitation is supported.

The first important declaration of the Convention is that it is not retroactive.
By the terms of article 4, its provisions are to apply, ex proprio vigore, only to treaties concluded after the Convention shall have entered into force.
